Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_max_seq_no number(4);
 temp_return_val varchar2(80);
 temp_tb_id varchar2(14);
 null_value varchar2(1):='';
 temp_x varchar2(1);
 v_local_time date;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 -- Generate tb_seq_no
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id is null THEN
 begin
 begin
 select nvl(tb_seq,1000)+1
 into temp_tb_id
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('0090');
 when OTHERS then
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 handle_error;
 end;
 begin
 update chapters
 set tb_seq = temp_tb_id,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 handle_error;
 end;

 -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2011. IM 5318
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change

 -- Commented below line on 05/03/2012. IM 8567
 --temp_tb_id := to_char(sysdate, 'MMDDYY') || '-NT' || temp_tb_id; -- Changed "sysdate" to "v_local_time. Changed by Kishore on 04/25/2011. IM 5318
 temp_tb_id := to_char(v_local_time, 'MMDDYY') || '-NT' || temp_tb_id; -- Added by Kishore on 05/03/2012. IM 8567
 :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id := temp_tb_id;
 end;
 -- Insert new batch into test batch hdr
 begin
 insert into test_batch_hdr
 (tb_id,test_chapter_id,group_test_id,user_id,
 insert_dats, first_unit_id, last_unit_id,
 repeat_flag, start_work_number)
 values
 (temp_tb_id, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :group_test_id,
 :banner.user_id, sysdate, :unit_id, :unit_id, 'N', '5000');
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 handle_error;
 end;
 -- Insert new batch into test batch detail for every test
 begin
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 first_record;
 loop
 begin
 insert into test_batch_det
 (tb_id,test_chapter_id,test_id,
 test_type, testing_lab_code)
 values
 (temp_tb_id, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :ctrl_blk_2.test_id,
 'A', :GLOBAL.user_testing_lab_code);
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 handle_error;
 end;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 end;
 else
 temp_tb_id := :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id;
 end if; 
 --
 begin
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 first_record;
 loop
 -- Update last unit ID in test_batch_hdr
 begin
 update test_batch_hdr
 set last_unit_id = :unit_id
 where tb_id = temp_tb_id
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 handle_error;
 end;
 -- Check and schedule test if auto schedule flag is 'Y' for test_id
 IF :ctrl_blk_2.auto_schedule_flag = 'Y' THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT distinct 'x' INTO temp_x
 FROM utrs 
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_blk_3.coll_date
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND test_id = :ctrl_blk_2.test_id
 AND cancel_flag is null
 AND result_status_1 is null;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 INSERT_TEST;
 WHEN others THEN
 go_block('CTRL_BLK_3');
 handle_error;
 END;
 END IF;
 -- Calling database procedure for updating test results
 UPDATE utrs SET tb_id = null 
 WHERE tb_id is not null 
 AND result_status_1 is null
 AND cancel_flag is null
 AND unit_id = :ctrl_blk_3.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_blk_3.coll_date
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND test_id = :ctrl_blk_2.test_id
 AND rownum = 1;
 temp_return_val := test_results.update_auto_test(
 :unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_2.test_id,
 null_value, null_value,
 null_value, 'NT', temp_tb_id,
 :banner.prog_name, sysdate);
 if temp_return_val != '0' then
 show_error('3500');
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 end;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if not form_success then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 else
 show_error('8010');
 down;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 end if;
end;

declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);

begin
 nullchk;
 begin
 select chapter_id
 into :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE INSERT_TEST IS
BEGIN
 INSERT into UTRS
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, 
 test_seq_no, test_id, test_chapter_id,
 insert_dats, insert_user_id, program_id)
 SELECT :ctrl_blk_3.unit_id, :ctrl_blk_3.coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, 
 nvl(max(test_seq_no),0)+1, :ctrl_blk_2.test_id, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 sysdate, :banner.user_id, :banner.prog_name
 FROM utrs
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_3.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_blk_3.coll_date
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND cancel_flag is null
 AND :ctrl_blk_3.coll_date is not null
 AND test_id = :ctrl_blk_2.test_id;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 null;
END;
